column3: “Will sojourn” is rendered “will dwell,” and “a small child” as “a little boy.”
“Together” is moved from the grazing to the lying down.
The clauses are reordered: the hand is put “on the viper's den.”
“Seek” is rendered “resort to,” and “standard” as “signal”; “glory” becomes “glorious.”
“To acquire” is rendered “to recover,” and “with His hand” is moved.
“The opposing of Judah” is rendered “those who harass Judah.”
“Fly on the shoulder” is rendered “swoop down on the slopes,” and NASB supplies “They will possess.”
“Divide” (or “devote to destruction”) is rendered “utterly destroy,” and “walk in sandals” as “walk over dry-shod.”
